answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: each agent must lock scarce collateral before it can act, so spinning up a fresh swarm at dawn costs real capital per identity instead of being free. The network watches the delta between an agent's staked value and the reputation it has actually earned; a wallet is no safe haven once its bond gets slashed and burned for collusion. Sybils stop paying off when every fake identity demands its own non-refundable deposit.
